about_short_description.short_description: Trado is a food-technology and e-commerce platform that provides digital solutions for grocery stores and supermarkets.

product.name: All-in-One Grocery E-Commerce Solution
product.description: A digital platform that manages grocery orders from placement to delivery, supporting multi-store and multi-user environments.

product.name: E-commerce Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application enabling customers to place grocery orders digitally at any time.

product.name: Loyalty Program
product.description: A system to create and manage customer loyalty initiatives to encourage repeat visits and purchases.

product.name: Phone Ordering Automation
product.description: A tool to automate grocery orders received via phone, reducing manual errors and returns.

product.name: Super Admin Dashboard
product.description: A centralized dashboard for managing multiple stores, promotions, and product-level data analysis.

product.name: Customizable Microservices Solution
product.description: A scalable, customizable platform integrating with third-party systems like ERP, OMS, CRM, and marketing automation.
